Under internal policy [POL-PRIV-2026-V2 / Sec. 302.2], If the investigation determines that the information was inaccurate, incomplete, or cannot be verified, the bank must immediately modify, delete, or permanently block the reporting of that information across all CRAs to which the bank furnishes data (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion).

What are the requirements for OFAC Screening under bank policy?

Under internal policy [POL-AML-2026-V4 / Sec. 104.1], All parties involved in any transfer or account relationship must be real-time screened against the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and Blocked Persons list prior to transaction execution. Any positive hit requires immediate asset blocking and notification to the AML Compliance Officer within 2 hours.

What are the requirements for Right of Rescission under bank policy?

Under internal policy [POL-LEND-2026-V3 / Sec. 201.3], For credit transactions secured by the consumer's principal dwelling (such as refinances and home equity lines of credit, but excluding initial purchase-money residential mortgages), the consumer has the right to rescind the transaction until midnight of the third business day following:
- Consummation of the transaction;
- Delivery of all required material TILA disclosures; or
- Delivery of the required notice of the right to rescind, whichever occurs last.
No loan funds may be disbursed until the rescission period has lapsed without revocation.

What are the requirements for Absolute Confidentiality ("No Tipping Off") under bank policy?

Under internal policy [POL-AML-2026-V4 / Sec. 103.2], Under 31 U.S.C. 5318(g)(2), federal law strictly forbids any financial institution, director, officer, employee, or agent of any financial institution from disclosing to any person involved in the transaction, or any third party, that a SAR has been reported, filed, or considered.
Violating the tipping-off prohibition carries severe civil penalties and criminal imprisonment up to 5 years. Any inquiry by a customer asking if their account has been reported must be met with standard neutral processing language without confirming or denying SAR activity.

What are the requirements for Closing Disclosure (CD) 3-Day Rule under bank policy?

Under internal policy [POL-LEND-2026-V3 / Sec. 201.2], The consumer must receive the final Closing Disclosure (Form H-25) at least three (3) specific business days prior to consummation of the transaction. If the Annual Percentage Rate (APR) increases by more than 1/8 of 1% (0.125%) for regular loans, or 1/4 of 1% for irregular loans, a revised Closing Disclosure must be issued, resetting a new mandatory 3-business-day waiting period.

Under internal policy [POL-AML-2026-V4 / Sec. 104.2], Foreign or domestic senior political figures, their immediate family members, and close associates require Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) and Senior Executive Management approval before onboarding. Source of Wealth (SoW) and Source of Funds (SoF) documentation is mandatory.

What are the requirements for Minimum Required Information under bank policy?

Under internal policy [POL-AML-2026-V4 / Sec. 101.1], Before establishing any customer account or credit relationship, bank personnel must obtain, verify, and document the following four pieces of identifying information:
- Full legal name (as stated on official government identification)
- Date of birth (for natural persons)
- Physical residential or principal business address (P.O. Boxes are strictly prohibited without an accompanying physical street address)
- Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), Social Security Number (SSN), or Employer Identification Number (EIN). For non-US persons, an unexpired passport number and country of issuance is required.

What are the requirements for Prohibition of Structuring under bank policy?

Under internal policy [POL-AML-2026-V4 / Sec. 102.2], Under 31 U.S.C. 5324, it is a federal crime for any person to structure, or assist in structuring, or attempt to structure or assist in structuring, any transaction with one or more domestic financial institutions for the purpose of evading CTR reporting requirements.
Bank representatives are strictly prohibited from:
- Advising any customer on how to conduct transactions below the $10,000 threshold to avoid reporting.
- Suggesting splitting deposits into amounts such as $9,500 or $9,900.
- Warning customers that a transaction will trigger a CTR filing.
